summary:
Iteration 5 verification of the two HIGH iteration-4 bugs plus 3 new features and full regression. Backend: 60/60 pytest pass (incl. new /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_sse_vision.py, 8/8). Both HIGH bugs are FIXED and verified end-to-end: (1) vision now answers in the selected language (DE difetti+ingredienti German, IT Italian - verified via API and UI with a real JPEG), (2) SSE is now JSON-framed ({"d":...}/{"done":true}), newlines/blank lines survive and the UI renders real
    /
  • //

    /

    with zero raw '##'/'**'/'---' leaks in both chat-msg-assistant and photo-result. New features verified: bio-card (IT/DE), 6 news items (2 Stoccarda highlighted + 2 Germania + 2 Italia, translated), Maestro hub with 5 tools, and 'Attacca gli impasti' (StartDoughs) forward planner - rest defaults from recipe bulk+proof (360/390 min), start = ready - rest, ordering earliest-mix-first, ready time last, sd-load-day correctly loads a weekly-plan day. Regression all pass: lang switch+persistence (localStorage mikilab_lang), recipe create/edit/duplicate/scale/delete-with-confirm, weekly plan save/persist/print/share(clipboard), oven CRUD + timer start/tick/reset, announcements CRUD with delete confirm+cancel, photo both modes. No 'Calcola gradi' and no freezer anywhere in the rendered app.

minor.issue: Singleton production plan has no DELETE/reset endpoint, so test/stale data can only be overwritten (I reset it to bake_time 2026-07-20T07:00 with phases: []).
Error placeholder text '[Errore nell analisi. Riprova.]' is hardcoded Italian and is not localized by lang (also lost its apostrophe vs. earlier iterations).

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard/share failures are swallowed by an empty catch, so when clipboard access is blocked the user gets no feedback at all (reproduced in a context without clipboard permission: no toast). Should show an error toast.
sd-rest-{id} is an unbounded number input: clearing it or entering a negative value yields start == ready (or start after ready) with no validation/warning.

Ambiguous test ids: 'recipe-flour-input' is the flour TYPE text field while the flour weight is 'recipe-flour_grams-input' - easy source of false test failures; consider renaming to recipe-flour-type-input.

issues: sd-ready-time and bake-time-input are native datetime-local inputs rendering in US mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm AM format regardless of IT/DE language; not a localized/shadcn date-time picker
Seeded announcement titles/bodies remain Italian in DE mode (DB seed data, pre-existing)
No contrast or spacing problems found; bio card white-on-terracotta and highlighted Stuttgart news (amber tint + solid tag) read clearly

action_items: Optional: show an error toast when clipboard/share fails in WeeklyPlan.sharePlan instead of an empty catch
Optional: validate sd-rest-{id} (min 1, non-empty) in StartDoughs
Optional: localize the vision error placeholder string per lang
Optional cleanup: /app/frontend/src/sections/CalcolaGradi.jsx is dead code (no imports anywhere) - delete it
Optional: replace native datetime-local inputs with a localized date-time control
critical_code_review_comments: SSE contract is now newline-safe (json.dumps per frame) and the frontend parses each frame with JSON.parse - verified strictly: every data line in chat and vision streams is JSON-parseable and the stream terminates with {"done": true}.
VISION_PROMPTS no longer contain a hardcoded 'Rispondi in italiano', so LANG_DIRECTIVE is the single source of truth for language - verified German output for both modes.
translations.js key parity intact: 187 IT keys == 187 DE keys, no missing keys after adding bio_*, sd_*, tool_inforna/impasti, news_region_*.
StartDoughs.compute() is pure client-side and unpersisted (per spec); no backend endpoint added, so nothing to validate server-side.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (only 3 LOW-severity polish items)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only: personal recipes 'TEST_i5 Pane' (+duplicate, +scaled, +edit) all deleted; oven profile 'TEST_i5 Forno' deleted; announcement 'TEST_i5 Avviso' deleted; weekly-plan test items removed and plan saved empty. Baseline verified after cleanup: 3 mikilab recipes, 0 personal, 0 oven profiles, 2 seeded announcements, weekly-plan items = []. production-plan singleton reset to phases: [] (stale 'TEST_NoHours' phase from iteration 4 removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (60 tests, ~2min; AI/vision tests dominate runtime). SSE helpers in all suites were migrated to the JSON contract ({'d':delta} / {'done':true}) - do NOT reintroduce '[DONE]' assertions. Frontend notes: news tags render uppercase via CSS so inner_text returns 'STUTTGART'/'STOCCARDA' - compare case-insensitively. WeeklyPlan/StartDoughs load data asynchronously: wait for [data-testid^='weekly-pieces-'] (not just the day cards) before counting rows, otherwise you get a false 0. Oven timer widgets only render when a profile has phaseN_minutes set. weekly print can be captured by stubbing window.open and reading the document.write payload; share needs clipboard permissions granted or it silently no-ops.
rca_of_the_issue:
Both iteration-4 HIGH defects are resolved. (1) Vision language: removing 'Rispondi in italiano' from VISION_PROMPTS left LANG_DIRECTIVE authoritative; DE requests now score de>>it (e.g. de=21 vs it=8) and IT requests stay Italian. (2) Markdown: JSON-encoding each SSE delta prevents the client split('

') from consuming model newlines; backend test asserts '

' is present in the reassembled text and the UI now emits real <ul>/<li>/<strong>/<h2> with no raw markers.
